lines: Oh! You look good at asking grown-ups for things.
I'm Melanie. I have a VERY serious problem.
The Void has a zipline, a tree house, a nap cloud...
But NO WATER SLIDE!
YES. Two serious faces are better than one.
His window's on the Town Hall. Mornings till teatime!
Okay. I'll practise my serious face.
Mr. Palmer's window, on the Town Hall. Go in the day.
Serious face. No giggling.
"Patience"? I've been patient since breakfast!
He went twitchy when I said "the old slide".
It's in the Spooky Woods, boarded up. Ask Bramble, Pip or Dash why.
The Spooky Woods? On purpose? Brave.
I'll guard the Town Hall. Not because I'm scared.
The Spooky Woods? On purpose? Brave.
I'll guard the Town Hall. Not because I'm scared.
The Spooky Woods? On purpose? Brave.
I'll guard the Town Hall. Not because I'm scared.
{player}: Something GREEN and GIGGLY flew out of the Haunted House!
And you just... let it?
New plan. Forget the spooky old house.
A cloud over the lake, with a slide down into the water!
And a toy store on top!
Go tell Mr. Palmer! Use the face.
Go on! Tell him about the cloud slide!

rotate: A cloud slide! I'll go down it a thousand times!
Mr. Palmer says waiting made it better.
Seen anything green and giggly? Me neither. Probably.
Serious face. Still working on it.
